#!/usr/bin/env node
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { pathToFileURL, fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { gunzipSync, gzipSync } from "node:zlib";
import { validateProbeDefinition } from "../lib/kafka-acl-probe-runtime.mjs";
import {
  deriveProbeMatrix,
  planPrincipal,
  requireBinding,
  requirePreflight,
  assertEmpty,
  validateProbeReceipt,
} from "../lib/kafka-acl-probe-plan.mjs";
import {
  environment,
  readLatch,
  awsReader,
} from "../lib/rebuild-admission.mjs";
import {
  requireIdleKafkaClients,
  writeAclEvidence,
} from "../lib/kafka-acl-evidence.mjs";
import { kafkaAdminPrelude } from "../lib/kafka-onbox-admin.mjs";
import {
  commandCaptureShell,
  checkedCapture,
  parseTopicInventory,
} from "../lib/kafka-client-snapshot.mjs";
import {
  listChunkCommand,
  verifyListPayload,
} from "../lib/kafka-acl-apply.mjs";
import { waitForCommandInvocation } from "./ssm-command-waiter.mjs";
import {
  producerInventory,
  proveProducerHold,
} from "../lib/clickhouse-native-init-producer-hold.mjs";
import { waitForTaskStop } from "../lib/ecs-task-wait.mjs";
const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../", import.meta.url));
const json = (path) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, "utf8"));
const fail = (message) => {
  throw new Error(message);
};
function run(command, args) {
  const r = spawnSync(command, args, {
    encoding: "utf8",
    maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
    timeout: 30 * 60 * 1000,
  });
  if (r.error || r.status !== 0) fail(`${command} failed`);
  return r.stdout;
}
export function options(argv) {
  const flags = new Set([
      "env",
      "stage",
      "principal",
      "preflight",
      "dry-run",
      "runtime",
      "preflight-dir",
      "pre-topic-receipt",
      "profile",
      "evidence-prefix",
    ]),
    args = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {
    const key = argv[i].slice(2);
    if (
      !argv[i].startsWith("--") ||
      !flags.has(key) ||
      Object.hasOwn(args, key)
    )
      fail("invalid option");
    args[key] = ["dry-run", "preflight"].includes(key) ? true : argv[++i];
    if (args[key] === undefined || String(args[key]).startsWith("--"))
      fail("option value missing");
  }
  if (!["pre-topic", "post-topic"].includes(args.stage))
    fail("--stage pre-topic|post-topic required");
  if (args.env !== "dev") fail("only dev is wired for probe execution");
  return args;
}
export function parseOffsets(text, inventory) {
  const expected = new Set(
      inventory.flatMap((t) => t.partitions.map((p) => `${t.topic}:${p}`)),
    ),
    result = new Map();
  for (const line of text.trim().split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean)) {
    const m = /^([^:\s]+):(\d+):(\d+)$/.exec(line),
      key = m && `${m[1]}:${m[2]}`;
    if (!m || !expected.has(key) || result.has(key))
      fail("offset inventory differs");
    result.set(key, m[3]);
  }
  if (result.size !== expected.size) fail("offset inventory incomplete");
  return result;
}
export function requireProbeTaskSuccess(waited) {
  const task = waited?.task;
  if (
    waited?.stopped !== true ||
    task?.lastStatus !== "STOPPED" ||
    task.stopCode !== "EssentialContainerExited" ||
    task.containers?.length !== 1 ||
    task.containers[0].exitCode !== 0
  )
    fail("probe task failed, including ResourceInitializationError");
  return task;
}
export async function main(argv) {
  const args = options(argv),
    manifest = json(resolve(root, "plan/kafka/acl-manifest.dev.v1.json")),
    matrix = deriveProbeMatrix(manifest);
  if (
    JSON.stringify(matrix) !==
    JSON.stringify(json(resolve(root, "plan/kafka/acl-probe-matrix.v1.json")))
  )
    fail("probe matrix stale");
  const selected = matrix.principals.filter(
    (p) =>
      (!args.principal || p.principal === args.principal) &&
      (args.preflight || args.stage !== "pre-topic" || p.class === "P"),
  );
  if (!selected.length) fail("no principal selected");
  if (args["dry-run"]) {
    const report = {
      stage: args.stage,
      preflight: !!args.preflight,
      manifest_sha256: manifest.sha256,
      principals: matrix.principals.map((p) => ({
        principal: p.principal,
        class: p.class,
        stage_selected: selected.includes(p),
        probe_count: args.preflight
          ? 0
          : planPrincipal(manifest, p.principal, {
              stage: p.class === "P" ? args.stage : "post-topic",
            }).probes.length,
      })),
    };
    console.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
    return report;
  }
  if (!args.runtime || !args["preflight-dir"] || !args["evidence-prefix"])
    fail("--runtime, --preflight-dir and --evidence-prefix required");
  const target = environment(args.env),
    aws = awsReader(target, { profile: args.profile ?? "crpko-dev" }),
    runtime = json(resolve(args.runtime)),
    runId = randomUUID(),
    date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    localDir = resolve(
      root,
      `tmp/dev-rebuild-${date}/kafka-authz/probes/${runId}`,
    );
  if (aws(["sts", "get-caller-identity"]).Account !== target.account_id)
    fail("account differs");
  const latch = readLatch(target, { ssm: aws });
  if (!latch) fail("installation latch required");
  if (
    !/^s3:\/\/crpko-dev-evidence\/rebuild\/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\/kafka-authz\/[A-Za-z0-9/_-]+$/.test(
      args["evidence-prefix"],
    )
  )
    fail("invalid evidence prefix");
  const prefix = args["evidence-prefix"];
  const verify = (label) => {
    const text = run(process.execPath, [
      resolve(root, "scripts/runbooks/apply-kafka-acls.mjs"),
      "--env",
      target.env,
      "--region",
      target.region,
      "--profile",
      args.profile ?? "crpko-dev",
      "--mode",
      "verify",
      "--admin-auth",
      "broker-scram",
      "--evidence-out",
      `${prefix}/${runId}-${label}.json`,
    ]);
    const report = JSON.parse(text);
    if (!report.ok || !report.evidence?.local_path) fail("G-ACL verify failed");
    return json(report.evidence.local_path);
  };
  const clientsIdle = () => {
    requireIdleKafkaClients({ awsJson: aws, env: target.env });
    proveProducerHold({
      awsJson: aws,
      env: target.env,
      inventory: producerInventory(
        manifest,
        json(resolve(root, "plan/kafka/acl-principals.v1.json")),
      ),
    });
  };
  clientsIdle();
  const binding = verify("before");
  if (
    binding.installation_id !== latch.installation_id ||
    binding.manifest_sha256 !== manifest.sha256
  )
    fail("installation or manifest differs");
  const ssm = (instance, shell) => {
    const response = aws([
      "ssm",
      "send-command",
      "--instance-ids",
      instance,
      "--document-name",
      "AWS-RunShellScript",
      "--parameters",
      JSON.stringify({ commands: [shell] }),
      "--timeout-seconds",
      "120",
    ]);
    const invocation = waitForCommandInvocation({
      commandId: response.Command?.CommandId,
      instanceId: instance,
      timeoutSeconds: "180",
      getInvocation: (c, i) =>
        aws([
          "ssm",
          "get-command-invocation",
          "--command-id",
          c,
          "--instance-id",
          i,
        ]),
    });
    if (
      invocation.Status !== "Success" ||
      invocation.ResponseCode !== 0 ||
      invocation.StandardErrorContent
    )
      fail("broker capture failed");
    return invocation.StandardOutputContent;
  };
  const prelude = kafkaAdminPrelude({ env: target.env, region: target.region });
  const capture = (command) => {
    const header = ssm(
        binding.instance_ids[0],
        commandCaptureShell(prelude, command),
      ).trim(),
      m =
        /^FILE (\/tmp\/kafka-acls-list\.[A-Za-z0-9]+) LEN (\d+) SHA ([a-f0-9]{64})$/.exec(
          header,
        );
    if (!m) fail("capture header differs");
    const length = Number(m[2]);
    if (length < 1 || length > 8 * 1024 * 1024) fail("capture exceeds limit");
    let encoded = "";
    try {
      for (let start = 0; start < length; start += 20000)
        encoded += ssm(
          binding.instance_ids[0],
          listChunkCommand(m[1], start, 20000),
        );
      verifyListPayload({ encoded, length, sha256: m[3] });
      return checkedCapture(
        JSON.parse(gunzipSync(Buffer.from(encoded, "base64")).toString()),
        "probe inventory",
      ).text;
    } finally {
      ssm(binding.instance_ids[0], `rm -f -- '${m[1]}'`);
    }
  };
  for (const instance of binding.instance_ids)
    ssm(
      instance,
      'set -euo pipefail\ngrep -Eq "^listeners=.*:9097(,|$)" /opt/kafka/config/kraft.properties\nss -ltn | grep -Eq ":9097[[:space:]]"\necho TLS_STAGE_B',
    );
  const requireExporterHold = () => {
    for (const instance of binding.instance_ids)
      ssm(
        instance,
        'set -euo pipefail\ntest -f /var/lib/crpko-kafka/exporter-hold\nfor UNIT in crpko-kafka-tiering-exporter crpko-kafka-lso-lag-exporter; do if systemctl is-active --quiet "$UNIT"; then exit 1; fi; done\necho EXPORTERS_HELD',
      );
  };
  requireExporterHold();
  const base = '--bootstrap-server "$BOOT" --command-config "$CFG"';
  const names = capture(
    `/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh ${base} --list --exclude-internal`,
  );
  if (names.split(/\r?\n/).includes("crpko-acl-probe-absent"))
    fail("sentinel exists");
  let inventory = [],
    topology = {};
  if (!args.preflight && args.stage === "post-topic") {
    const described = capture(
      `/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh ${base} --describe --exclude-internal`,
    );
    inventory = parseTopicInventory(names, described);
    const starts = parseOffsets(
        capture(
          `/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-get-offsets.sh ${base} --time -2 --exclude-internal-topics`,
        ),
        inventory,
      ),
      ends = parseOffsets(
        capture(
          `/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-get-offsets.sh ${base} --time -1 --exclude-internal-topics`,
        ),
        inventory,
      );
    const leaders = new Map(
      [
        ...described.matchAll(
          /Topic:\s+(\S+)\s+Partition:\s+(\d+)\s+Leader:\s+(\d+)/g,
        ),
      ].map((m) => [`${m[1]}:${m[2]}`, Number(m[3])]),
    );
    for (const topic of inventory)
      topology[topic.topic] = topic.partitions.map((partition) => ({
        partition,
        start: starts.get(`${topic.topic}:${partition}`),
        end: ends.get(`${topic.topic}:${partition}`),
        leader: leaders.get(`${topic.topic}:${partition}`),
      }));
  }
  if (!args.preflight) {
    requirePreflight(
      matrix.principals.map((p) =>
        json(resolve(args["preflight-dir"], `${p.principal}.json`)),
      ),
      binding,
      matrix.principals.map((p) => p.principal),
    );
    if (args.stage === "post-topic") {
      if (!args["pre-topic-receipt"]) fail("K6p receipt required");
      const pre = json(resolve(args["pre-topic-receipt"]));
      requireBinding(pre, binding);
      validateProbeReceipt(pre, manifest, "topic_provisioner", {
        stage: "pre-topic",
        run: pre.run_id,
      });
    }
  }
  const receipts = [];
  for (const entry of selected) {
    clientsIdle();
    requireExporterHold();
    requireBinding(verify(`before-${entry.principal}`), binding);
    const definition = aws([
      "ecs",
      "describe-task-definition",
      "--task-definition",
      runtime.tasks?.[entry.principal] ?? fail("probe definition missing"),
    ]).taskDefinition;
    const container = validateProbeDefinition(
      definition,
      runtime,
      entry,
      target,
    );
    const endpoints = container.environment
      .find((e) => e.name === "KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_BROKERS")
      .value.split(",");
    const plan = args.preflight
      ? null
      : planPrincipal(manifest, entry.principal, {
          stage: args.stage,
          run: runId,
        });
    if (plan) {
      const existing = new Set(
        capture(`/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh ${base} --list`)
          .trim()
          .split(/\r?\n/),
      );
      for (const probe of plan.probes)
        if (
          probe.expected === "TOPIC_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED" &&
          probe.resource !== "crpko-acl-probe-absent" &&
          [
            "Fetch",
            "ListOffsets",
            "Metadata",
            "DescribeConfigs",
            "AlterConfigs",
            "IncrementalAlterConfigs",
            "DeleteRecords",
          ].includes(probe.api) &&
          !existing.has(probe.resource)
        )
          fail(`negative topic does not exist: ${probe.resource}`);
    }
    const needed = new Set(
      plan?.probes
        .filter(
          (p) =>
            ["Fetch", "ListOffsets"].includes(p.api) &&
            (p.expected === "TOPIC_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED" ||
              entry.class === "H"),
        )
        .map((p) => p.resource),
    );
    const foreign = Object.fromEntries(
      [...needed]
        .filter((t) => topology[t])
        .map((t) => [
          t,
          topology[t]
            .filter((p) => entry.class === "H" || p.partition === 0)
            .map((p) => ({
              ...p,
              endpoint: `broker-${p.leader}.${endpoints[0].split(":")[0].replace(/^kafka\./, "")}:${entry.port}`,
            })),
        ]),
    );
    const bindingFields = Object.fromEntries(
      [
        "installation_id",
        "environment",
        "account_id",
        "region",
        "cluster_id",
        "format_sha256",
        "manifest_sha256",
        "listing_sha256",
        "user_list_sha256",
      ].map((k) => [k, binding[k]]),
    );
    const command = [
      "--principal",
      entry.principal,
      ...(args.preflight
        ? ["--preflight"]
        : [
            "--stage",
            args.stage,
            "--run",
            runId,
            "--topology",
            gzipSync(JSON.stringify(foreign)).toString("base64"),
            "--binding",
            JSON.stringify(bindingFields),
          ]),
    ];
    const overrides = {
      containerOverrides: [{ name: "kafka-acl-probe", command }],
    };
    if (JSON.stringify(overrides).length > 8192)
      fail("probe override too large");
    const network = runtime.networks?.[entry.principal];
    if (
      !network?.subnets?.length ||
      network.securityGroups?.length !== 1 ||
      network.assignPublicIp !== "DISABLED"
    )
      fail("probe network missing");
    const started = aws([
      "ecs",
      "run-task",
      "--cluster",
      `crpko-${target.env}`,
      "--task-definition",
      definition.taskDefinitionArn,
      "--launch-type",
      "FARGATE",
      "--count",
      "1",
      "--client-token",
      `${runId}-${receipts.length}`,
      "--network-configuration",
      JSON.stringify({ awsvpcConfiguration: network }),
      "--overrides",
      JSON.stringify(overrides),
    ]);
    if (started.failures?.length || started.tasks?.length !== 1)
      fail("probe task did not start");
    const taskArn = started.tasks[0].taskArn;
    mkdirSync(localDir, { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(
      resolve(localDir, `${entry.principal}.task.json`),
      JSON.stringify({
        principal: entry.principal,
        run_id: runId,
        task_arn: taskArn,
        task_definition_arn: definition.taskDefinitionArn,
      }) + "\n",
      { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 },
    );
    console.error(`Following probe ${entry.principal}: ${taskArn}`);
    const waited = waitForTaskStop({
      budgetMs: 30 * 60 * 1000,
      describeTask: () => {
        const response = aws([
          "ecs",
          "describe-tasks",
          "--cluster",
          `crpko-${target.env}`,
          "--tasks",
          taskArn,
        ]);
        if (response.failures?.length || response.tasks?.length !== 1)
          fail("task state unavailable");
        return { task: response.tasks[0] };
      },
    });
    requireProbeTaskSuccess(waited);
    const logGroup = container.logConfiguration.options["awslogs-group"],
      stream = `probe/kafka-acl-probe/${taskArn.split("/").at(-1)}`;
    const logs = aws([
      "logs",
      "get-log-events",
      "--log-group-name",
      logGroup,
      "--log-stream-name",
      stream,
      "--start-from-head",
    ]);
    const lines = logs.events?.filter((e) =>
      e.message.startsWith("CRPKO_PROBE_RESULT "),
    );
    if (lines?.length !== 1) fail("probe result missing or duplicated");
    const result = JSON.parse(
      lines[0].message.slice("CRPKO_PROBE_RESULT ".length),
    );
    if (
      result.principal !== entry.principal ||
      result.passed !== true ||
      !!result.preflight !== !!args.preflight
    )
      fail("probe result differs");
    if (args.preflight) {
      if (result.username !== entry.principal)
        fail("preflight username differs");
    } else {
      requireBinding(result, binding);
      validateProbeReceipt(result, manifest, entry.principal, {
        stage: args.stage,
        run: runId,
      });
    }
    clientsIdle();
    requireExporterHold();
    requireBinding(verify(`after-${entry.principal}`), binding);
    const receipt = {
      ...binding,
      ...result,
      task_arn: taskArn,
      task_definition_arn: definition.taskDefinitionArn,
      image: container.image,
      run_id: runId,
      captured_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    receipts.push(receipt);
  }
  if (!args.preflight && args.stage === "post-topic") {
    const topics = [
      ...new Set(
        manifest.rows
          .filter(
            (r) =>
              r.principal === "User:clickhouse_balance_bootstrap" &&
              r.resource_type === "TOPIC",
          )
          .map((r) => r.resource_name),
      ),
    ];
    const starts = parseOffsets(
        capture(
          `/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-get-offsets.sh ${base} --time -2 --exclude-internal-topics`,
        ),
        inventory,
      ),
      ends = parseOffsets(
        capture(
          `/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-get-offsets.sh ${base} --time -1 --exclude-internal-topics`,
        ),
        inventory,
      );
    assertEmpty(
      Object.fromEntries(
        inventory.map((t) => [
          t.topic,
          t.partitions.map((partition) => ({
            partition,
            start: starts.get(`${t.topic}:${partition}`),
            end: ends.get(`${t.topic}:${partition}`),
          })),
        ]),
      ),
      topics,
    );
  }
  requireBinding(verify("final"), binding);
  if (
    readLatch(target, { ssm: aws })?.installation_id !== latch.installation_id
  )
    fail("installation changed");
  mkdirSync(localDir, { recursive: true });
  for (const receipt of receipts) {
    writeAclEvidence({
      awsJson: aws,
      evidence: receipt,
      localPath: resolve(localDir, `${receipt.principal}.json`),
      uri: `${prefix}/probes/${runId}/${receipt.principal}.json`,
    });
    if (args.preflight) {
      mkdirSync(resolve(args["preflight-dir"]), { recursive: true });
      writeFileSync(
        resolve(args["preflight-dir"], `${receipt.principal}.json`),
        JSON.stringify(receipt) + "\n",
        { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 },
      );
    }
  }
  console.log(
    JSON.stringify({
      passed: true,
      stage: args.stage,
      local_dir: localDir,
      principals: receipts.map((r) => r.principal),
    }),
  );
  return receipts;
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href)
  main(process.argv.slice(2)).catch((e) => {
    console.error(e.message);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  });
